summary: Specifies Multipath TCP, a set of extensions that let a single TCP connection use several paths at once. Applications still see an ordinary reliable byte stream, while the network gets better resource use, throughput, and resilience to failure. It obsoletes RFC 6824.

eli5.summary: Instead of using just one road, your data travels on several at once, like a river splitting into streams, and still arrives as a single flow.
